card.name: Technical action verbs in instructions
card.fires_on: Verbs or nouns for handling things in how-to text, such as reeze after ref, seal, mount, mounted and sending. It is mostly in technical manuals and computing guides.

modes.label: Handling verbs
modes.description: An action verb for treating a physical item or storage medium, such as sealing tubing or mounting a disk.
modes.example: Various methods may be used to<< seal>> tubing.

modes.label: Mounting disks
modes.description: The word mount or mounted for attaching a disk or ISO in Unix-style guides.
modes.example: Now the floppy disk can be<< mounted>> like any other disk.

modes.label: Other technical terms
modes.description: A technical noun or unit in a list or explanation, such as GB or authentication.
modes.example: SD cards can reach up to 4<<GB>> of storage space
